run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum possible difference between two subsets of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold with sample arrays to verify correct subset difference calculation
review_f_gold: review f_gold which eliminates duplicate elements and sums positive versus negative values
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array when zeroing duplicate elements
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the maximum difference between two subsets by separating unique positive and negative values
